# PeerJS 1.5.5

- Upstream: https://github.com/peers/peerjs
- Distribution: https://unpkg.com/peerjs@1.5.5/dist/peerjs.min.js
- License: MIT; see `peerjs-LICENSE.txt`.
- Only TV/phone companion pages load this dependency.
- PeerServer Cloud provides signaling. The application explicitly configures
  Google STUN and no TURN relay.
